# zobjinspect

**Tag**: web, testing, networking, filesystem

## 简介

* A set of utilities for inspecting object and library files generated by z80asm, the assembler from z88dk - http://www.z88dk.org/

## 官网

- 主页: http://zobjinspect.rubyforge.org
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/zobjinspect

## 历史版本号

- 1.0.0 (2009-08-05)

## 获取地址

- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/zobjinspect
- gem 安装: `gem install zobjinspect`
- Bundler: `gem "zobjinspect"`
- 最新版本: 1.0.0
- 最新版归档: https://rubygems.org/downloads/zobjinspect-1.0.0.gem
- 版本锁定: `gem "zobjinspect", "~> 1.0.0"`
- 中央仓库: https://rubygems.org/
